note.label: The Decayed State of Liberal Women

precepts.why:
God commands the brothers: “set thy face against the daughters of thy people, which prophesy out of their own heart; and prophesy thou against them.” Sisters say, you're always getting on the sisters. We get on you because the white man has tricked you and you have been deceived, and because you play an important role in rebuilding the nation. For the last sixty years the white man has used you to destroy the black community. So God says, set your face against these liberal women, the free thinkers who want to do whatever they want.

They prophesy out of their own heart, their own emotions: I don't feel it's wrong to wear pants; I don't see anything wrong with a blonde wig; Jesus loves everybody. No. Do what God says: wear skirts, and don't wear what pertains to a man. We prophesy against you so that you will see your wrongs and change, and so that the damage the white man has done to our community through our sisters can be undone.

Look at the decayed state of the liberal woman. One says there's nothing wrong with being an angry black woman; if she is angry she will raise her voice, twist her face and snap her neck. No sister should come with that spirit. That is no way to speak to your husband, or to anyone. Another had a man paying all the bills and taking care of her and the children, and she left him because she needed clarity and to find herself. Another left her husband of more than ten years because they outgrew each other, because he wanted her home and she wanted her career. Some sisters did the same and have repented: they left their husband thinking there was something better out there, and the next man did the same thing the first one did.

Genesis 2:18 shows what God made the woman to be: “It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him an help meet for him.” When God created woman, he said she is a help meet unto Adam, a good help. That is scriptural. Brothers, you want a woman who will help you build the kingdom, who will help build your dreams and help establish the kingdom of heaven. The liberal woman wants the benefit of a king without the patience or the work of helping him build.

That is what the civil rights did to our people. When this happens across the whole community, sons grow up with no father in the house and baby mamas instead of wives, and these things help destroy a community. Many sisters don't want accountability or responsibility, and there is a lot of work to do.

note.label: Are You A Strong Independent Woman?

points: Woe to the women that sew pillows to all armholes, to hunt souls: there are women that hunt souls. They're not trying to bring people to the Lord; they hunt souls for their own goal. Will ye pollute me among my people for handfuls of barley and for pieces of bread? These strong women will pollute the teachings of God for their own benefit, and set the wrong example that lines other women up for destruction.

note.label: Are You A Strong Independent Woman?

points: Behold, I am against your pillows, and I will tear them from your arms, and will let the souls go: how? With us teaching the right doctrine, freeing our people from these evil examples of what strong is supposed to be.

points: The word of the Lord came telling Ezekiel to prophesy against the prophets of Israel that prophesy out of their own hearts.

note.label: Ezekiel 13: Woe Unto the Foolish Prophets

points: Woe unto the foolish prophets that follow their own spirit and have seen nothing, just like the pastors today who follow the spirit of the white man, the spirit of Esau, Christmas, and all these things, changing our people and giving them a false sense of security that they will get the kingdom of heaven.

note.label: Ezekiel 13: Woe Unto the Foolish Prophets

points: The prophets are like the foxes in the desert, using craftiness in a ruined and wasted area of Israel to make gain among the people, the same as a well-groomed church in a run-down area of the hood where the pastor makes gain off the people.

note.label: Ezekiel 13: Woe Unto the Foolish Prophets

points: They have not gone up into the gaps nor made up the hedge for the house of Israel to stand in the battle in the day of the Lord, meaning they did not protect Israel from the Lord's wrath the way Moses stood in the gap when we went into idolatry.

note.label: Ezekiel 13: Woe Unto the Foolish Prophets

points: They have seen vanity and lying divination, saying the Lord sent them when He had not, making Israel hope their lies would be confirmed.

note.label: Ezekiel 13: Woe Unto the Foolish Prophets

points: Because they speak vanity and see lies, the Most High is against them; His hand will be upon the prophets that see vanity and divine lies.
They shall not be in the assembly of His people, nor written in the writing of the house of Israel, nor enter the land of Israel, meaning they will die in captivity.

note.label: Ezekiel 13: Woe Unto the Foolish Prophets

points: They have seduced His people with another spirit, saying peace when there is no peace, the way pastors today seduce our people with the spirit of white jesus and not the spirit of the Most High of this Bible.
One built a wall and others daubed it with untempered mortar, patchwork upon the wall of Jerusalem, the prophets saying peace and safety while telling the people to build the walls up.

note.label: Ezekiel 13: Woe Unto the Foolish Prophets

points: The Most High will rend the wall with a stormy wind in His fury, with an overflowing shower in His anger and great hailstones in His fury to consume it.

note.label: Ezekiel 13: Woe Unto the Foolish Prophets

points: He will break down the wall daubed with untempered mortar and bring it to the ground so its foundation is discovered, and they shall be consumed in the midst of it and know He is the Lord.

note.label: Ezekiel 13: Woe Unto the Foolish Prophets

points: He will accomplish His wrath upon the wall and upon them that daubed it, the prophets of Israel which prophesied concerning Jerusalem and saw visions of peace for her when there was no peace, because of our sins.

note.label: Ezekiel 13: Woe Unto the Foolish Prophets

points: Ezekiel is to set his face against the daughters of his people which prophesy out of their own heart, just like the female pastors today who want to prophesy and teach our people and teach the men.

note.label: Ezekiel 13: Woe Unto the Foolish Prophets

points: Woe to the women that sew pillows to all armholes and make kerchiefs upon the head of every stature to hunt souls; the pillows are the wide robe-like openings down the arm and the kerchief is the covering placed on the head.

note.label: Ezekiel 13: Woe Unto the Foolish Prophets

points: They hunt the souls of the Most High's people and pollute His word among the people, saying God loves everybody and praise white jesus, doing it back then for handfuls of barley and pieces of bread and today for money.

note.label: Ezekiel 13: Woe Unto the Foolish Prophets

points: The Most High is against their pillows, wherewith they hunt the souls to make them fly, meaning to fly into sin and wickedness; He will tear them from their arms and let the hunted souls go free.

note.label: Ezekiel 13: Woe Unto the Foolish Prophets

points: He will use men who keep His commandments to go out and teach the people the proper way and tear them from the arms of these wicked women.
He will tear their kerchiefs and deliver His people out of their hand, so they shall be no more in their hand to be hunted, and they shall know He is the Lord.

note.label: Ezekiel 13: Woe Unto the Foolish Prophets

points: With lies they made the heart of the righteous sad whom the Most High had not made sad, and strengthened the hands of the wicked that he should not return from his wicked way by promising him life.

That is what happens today: the righteous are made sad by these women carrying on with no Bible in hand, just talking lies, while they strengthen the hands of the wicked and the people that put them in power.

note.label: Ezekiel 13: Woe Unto the Foolish Prophets

points: Therefore they shall see no more vanity nor divine divinations, for the Most High will deliver His people out of their hand, and they shall know He is the Lord.
